audience: card program teams that issue and manage cards with Lithic

useCases.title: Find cards by state
useCases.text: List cards with their state and memo. Open one card to read its type and spend limit.

useCases.title: Review card transactions and their merchants
useCases.text: List transactions with their status and result. Open one transaction to read its events and merchant details.

useCases.title: Check account holder KYC and KYB status
useCases.text: List account holders, cardholders and business customers, with their KYC or KYB status. Open one to read its enrollment details.

useCases.title: Review financial accounts by type
useCases.text: List financial accounts with their type and status. Open one to read its balance settings.

useCases.title: Pause a card and unpause it later
useCases.text: Check the card state first. Pause the card so it declines new transactions. Unpause it to accept them again.
